account_invites_one_live_idx.name: account_invites_one_live_idx
account_invites_one_live_idx.where: consumed_at IS NULL AND superseded_at IS NULL

email_change_requests_one_live_idx.name: email_change_requests_one_live_idx
email_change_requests_one_live_idx.where: consumed_at IS NULL AND superseded_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL

password_reset_otps_one_live_idx.name: password_reset_otps_one_live_idx
password_reset_otps_one_live_idx.where: consumed_at IS NULL AND superseded_at IS NULL

admissions_discharge_check.name: admissions_discharge_check
admissions_discharge_check.value: discharged_at IS NULL OR discharged_at >= admitted_at

blood_requests_submitted_check.name: blood_requests_submitted_check
blood_requests_submitted_check.value:
status = 'draft' OR (
        request_id IS NOT NULL
        AND patient_snapshot IS NOT NULL
        AND doctor_snapshot IS NOT NULL
        AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL
        AND indication IS NOT NULL
        AND date_required IS NOT NULL
        AND blood_group IS NOT NULL
        AND product IS NOT NULL
        AND units IS NOT NULL
      )

blood_requests_blood_group_check.name: blood_requests_blood_group_check
blood_requests_blood_group_check.value: blood_group IS NULL OR blood_group IN ('O-', 'O+', 'A-', 'A+', 'B-', 'B+', 'AB-', 'AB+')

blood_requests_product_check.name: blood_requests_product_check
blood_requests_product_check.value: product IS NULL OR product IN ('whole_blood', 'prbc', 'platelet_concentrate', 'ffp', 'cryoprecipitate')

patients_age_check.name: patients_age_check
patients_age_check.value: dob IS NOT NULL OR (age IS NOT NULL AND age_unit IS NOT NULL)

patients_age_unit_check.name: patients_age_unit_check
patients_age_unit_check.value: age_unit IS NULL OR age_unit IN ('days', 'months', 'years')

bag_quarantines_resolution_check.name: bag_quarantines_resolution_check
bag_quarantines_resolution_check.value: resolution IS NULL OR resolution IN ('available', 'discarded')

blood_bags_reserved_check.name: blood_bags_reserved_check
blood_bags_reserved_check.value: status <> 'reserved' OR reserved_for_request_id IS NOT NULL

blood_bags_issued_check.name: blood_bags_issued_check
blood_bags_issued_check.value: status <> 'issued' OR (issued_to_request_id IS NOT NULL AND issued_at IS NOT NULL)

centre_decisions_consistency_check.name: centre_decisions_consistency_check
centre_decisions_consistency_check.value:
(decision = 'declined' AND units_issued = 0)
       OR (decision = 'approved' AND units_issued = units_requested)
       OR (decision = 'partial' AND units_issued > 0 AND units_issued < units_requested)

donor_demand_counters_check.name: donor_demand_counters_check
donor_demand_counters_check.value: donors_notified >= 0 AND confirmed_units >= 0 AND waitlisted_units >= 0 AND completed_units >= 0

donor_demand_confirmations_typed_group_c.name: donor_demand_confirmations_typed_group_check
donor_demand_confirmations_typed_group_c.value:
donated_blood_group IS NULL OR donated_blood_group IN
            ('O-', 'O+', 'A-', 'A+', 'B-', 'B+', 'AB-', 'AB+')

rfid_tags_assigned_check.name: rfid_tags_assigned_check
rfid_tags_assigned_check.value: status <> 'assigned' OR current_bag_id IS NOT NULL

tag_discrepancies_finding_check.name: tag_discrepancies_finding_check
tag_discrepancies_finding_check.value: finding IS NULL OR finding IN ('duplicate_tag', 'bag_missing', 'mis_scan')

tag_discrepancies_resolved_check.name: tag_discrepancies_resolved_check
tag_discrepancies_resolved_check.value:
(status = 'resolved') = (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND finding IS NOT NULL
                                    AND resolved_by IS NOT NULL AND note IS NOT NULL)
